_comment: Single source of truth for every project on the site. Edit here, or through admin.html, then run: node build/build.js . Order in this list is the order on the page. published:false keeps a project on file but off the site entirely. Empty fields and empty arrays are simply not rendered, so nothing half-written ever ships.

projects.title: Asmi
projects.subtitle: Brand identity for an apparel brand
projects.summary: A culturally inspired apparel brand built around one idea: that clothing can be a way of wearing your identity. Audience, positioning and personality first, then the logo system, type, palette and surface patterns.

projects.title: Sunlife International
projects.subtitle: Brand identity and stationery
projects.summary: A food and FMCG distributor operating in Nepal since 2002, and the authorised distributor for Foster Clark's and Fortune Foods. After 24 years of trust built on the shelf, a rebrand to finally look the part.

projects.title: Swirly
projects.subtitle: Brand identity and packaging
projects.summary: Ice cream that belongs to everyone. Joyful enough to excite a seven year old, nostalgic enough to take an adult straight back to childhood. Logo, a palette across eight flavours, typography, patterns and tub labels, all made to work at shelf scale.
projects.imageAlt: Swirly brand identity and packaging artwork

projects.title: Paloma
projects.subtitle: Holiday residence brand identity
projects.summary: A Mediterranean coastal retreat built around slow living. The mark is a scallop shell with a starfish at its centre, held to a single terracotta and warm cream palette across the whole stay.

projects.title: LUMEYA
projects.subtitle: Conscious luxury skincare
projects.summary: A full brand identity system for a conscious luxury skincare concept. Custom wordmark, a five colour palette, four SKUs and secondary touchpoints, all built around one conviction: dark is not just an aesthetic, it is a position.
projects.imageAlt: LUMEYA brand identity and packaging artwork

projects.title: Napur Gin
projects.subtitle: Branding and packaging
projects.summary: Brand identity and packaging for a gin label.
